data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display a list of items in a marquee style.
data.what_it_does: Provides a MarqueeList widget that allows displaying a list of items scrolling horizontally or vertically. Enables customization of scrolling speed and direction.
use_when: You need to display scrolling lists in a marquee style horizontally or vertically
You want to easily customize the scroll duration of a marquee list
avoid_when: You need complex data-driven lazy loading for millions of items
You need advanced touch interactions or gestures natively tied to the marquee items
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical scrolling directions
Allows customizing scrolling speed via scrollDuration
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond basic marquee scrolling
Does not document advanced event handling or item builder patterns
